title: Performance rating is normally distributed and unimodal
description: The target variable performance_rating follows a single normal distribution with no hidden subpopulations.
null_hypothesis: performance_rating is drawn from a single normal distribution.
alternative_hypothesis: performance_rating deviates from normality or contains multiple modes.
test_method: Shapiro-Wilk test for normality; visual inspection of histogram+KDE for multimodality.
linked_framing_check: Verify performance_rating distribution shape and check for subpopulations

title: Numeric features have linear associations with performance rating
description: At least one numeric feature (years_experience, training_hours, team_size, projects_completed, satisfaction_score, commute_minutes, remote_pct) has a statistically significant Pearson correlation with performance_rating.
null_hypothesis: All Pearson correlations between numeric features and performance_rating are zero.
alternative_hypothesis: At least one Pearson correlation is significantly different from zero after FDR correction.
test_method: Pearson correlation with p-values for each feature vs performance_rating; Benjamini-Hochberg correction.
linked_framing_check: Test for linear and nonlinear associations between each feature and performance_rating

title: Numeric features have nonlinear associations with performance rating
description: At least one feature has a nonlinear relationship with performance_rating detectable via rank correlation or distance correlation even if linear correlation is near zero.
null_hypothesis: Spearman rho and distance correlation between each feature and performance_rating are zero.
alternative_hypothesis: At least one nonlinear association is significant after FDR correction.
test_method: Spearman correlation and distance correlation for each feature vs performance_rating; permutation test for distance correlation significance.
linked_framing_check: Test for linear and nonlinear associations between each feature and performance_rating

title: Performance rating differs across salary bands
description: Mean or median performance_rating varies significantly across the five salary_band groups (L1-L5).
null_hypothesis: performance_rating distributions are identical across all salary_band groups.
alternative_hypothesis: At least one salary_band group has a different performance_rating distribution.
test_method: Kruskal-Wallis H-test across salary_band groups; post-hoc Dunn test if significant.
linked_framing_check: Verify performance_rating distribution shape and check for subpopulations

title: Numeric features exhibit multicollinearity
description: Pairwise correlations among numeric predictors are large enough to cause instability in regression estimates (VIF > 5).
null_hypothesis: All pairwise correlations among predictors are near zero and VIF values are below 5.
alternative_hypothesis: At least one pair of predictors has |r| > 0.5 or VIF > 5.
test_method: Pearson correlation matrix; VIF computation from OLS regression.
linked_framing_check: Check pairwise correlations among all numeric features for multicollinearity

title: A predictive model for performance rating beats the no-skill baseline
description: A regression model (linear or random forest) achieves cross-validated R-squared significantly greater than zero and RMSE significantly below the target standard deviation (~10).
null_hypothesis: No model achieves R-squared significantly greater than zero (permutation test p >= 0.05).
alternative_hypothesis: At least one model achieves R-squared significantly greater than zero.
test_method: 5-fold cross-validated R-squared for OLS and random forest; permutation test comparing observed R-squared to null distribution from 100 target shuffles.
linked_framing_check: Evaluate whether model performance exceeds a no-skill baseline

title: Salary band is predictable from numeric features
description: A classifier trained on numeric features predicts salary_band significantly better than the majority-class baseline (L5: 170/800 = 21.25%).
null_hypothesis: Classification accuracy does not exceed majority-class baseline.
alternative_hypothesis: Classification accuracy is significantly above majority-class baseline.
test_method: Random forest classifier with 5-fold CV; compare accuracy to 21.25% baseline; binomial test on accuracy.
linked_framing_check: Test whether salary_band is predictable from numeric features

title: Natural employee segments exist in the feature space
description: K-Means clustering on standardized numeric features yields clusters with silhouette score meaningfully above random expectation, indicating non-random structure.
null_hypothesis: No cluster solution achieves silhouette score above what would be expected from uniformly random data of the same dimensionality.
alternative_hypothesis: At least one k yields silhouette score substantially above random expectation.
test_method: K-Means for k=2..6; silhouette scores; compare to reference silhouette from shuffled data.
linked_framing_check: Assess whether any observed associations survive multiple-comparison correction

title: Observed associations survive multiple-comparison correction
description: After collecting all p-values from hypothesis tests H-02 through H-07, at least one remains significant under Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction at alpha=0.05.
null_hypothesis: No p-value survives FDR correction -- all apparent associations are compatible with chance.
alternative_hypothesis: At least one test remains significant after FDR correction.
test_method: Benjamini-Hochberg procedure on the full set of p-values collected from all tests.
linked_framing_check: Assess whether any observed associations survive multiple-comparison correction
